children.objective: Test whether AVX2 byte-shuffle/lookup mapping can replace the scalar per-character table accesses in full bulk blocks, then pack decoded quartets into output bytes. Keep this specifically as the AVX2 lookup strategy, not an AVX-512 or arithmetic-classification variant. Use a scalar tail for padding and residual input; do not overread or write beyond the decoded length. Preserve the ABI and exact count/data for every valid standard padded input, including small and empty inputs. Use the frozen build and target, with safe availability handling if required; modify only src/candidate.cpp. Check random valid inputs and other lengths, then compare repeated one-core timings.
children.subject: AVX2 lookup-based decoding and packing

children.objective: Test a contrasting AVX-512 strategy: classify Base64 alphabet ranges with vector comparisons and arithmetic, rather than a byte-shuffle lookup, then pack groups of sextets into output bytes. Use only instructions confirmed available in the frozen target/build, with safe fallback or dispatch if needed; do not change compiler flags or target. Handle padding, tails, and all valid lengths exactly without overreads or out-of-bounds writes. Modify only src/candidate.cpp; check random valid inputs and other lengths and compare repeated one-core timings.
children.subject: AVX-512 arithmetic classification and packing

children.objective: Isolate the scalar control-flow and output-packing costs: retain the existing 256-entry decode table, but decode complete four-character quartets directly to three bytes instead of using the stream state machine and its per-character end/error checks. Unroll only if it preserves exact handling of the final padded quartet. Do not add SIMD or replace the table with arithmetic mapping in this experiment. Preserve the ABI and exact output for every valid standard padded length; modify only src/candidate.cpp. Check random valid inputs and other lengths, then compare repeated one-core timings.
children.subject: Scalar table-based quartet decoding
